data.title: Global Sales of Professional Service Robots Surge 24%
data.description: Global shipments of professional service robots increased by 24% to almost 250,000 units in 2025, highlighting a successful shift to commercial automation. These findings are presented in the World Robotics 2026 Service Robots report by the IFR.
data.author: IFR International Federation of Robotics
